title: DEP-SEC: close #288 vue-router 5; fix LAB-023 AiAssistant route name
intent: Dependabot #288 (vue-router 4→5) is unlandable: npm ci ERESOLVE against pinia@2 and peers require vue≥3.5.34 / vite≥7.3. Close it, ignore vue-router and pinia semver-majors (Tranche C), and fix the cited LAB-023 dashboard link that targeted nonexistent route AiAssistantProject.
behavior_change: AI Assistant quick-link now navigates to production route AiAssistant with optional project_id param (previously broken named route). Dependabot intake no longer opens vue-router/pinia majors.
